channel.title: Le KiosKe : International
channel.description: Catégorie « International » du KiosKe : articles et vidéos des sources suivies, mis à jour automatiquement.

item.title: The Pink Times : Mario Rossi appears in Antony Kozz's latest DNA gallery
item.description: DNA magazine has published a new photo gallery featuring model Mario Rossi and photographer Antony Kozz, with credits listed in the post.

item.title: The Pink Times : Tom Francis joins the second season of Overcompensating as Benny's new love interest
item.description: Benito Skinner says the Prime Video comedy is returning with more family drama, more sex and a new crew team captain for Benny.

item.title: The Pink Times : Deep Sen pictured in Archan Mukherjee’s latest DNA gallery
item.description: The new photo set pairs Deep Sen with a short photographer’s note about the model’s fitness journey and presence on camera.

item.title: The Pink Times : Central Europe’s queer past takes centre stage in Vratislav Maňák’s gay-sauna travelogue
item.description: Vratislav Maňák’s new book links Wittgenstein, Budapest, Prague and Vienna to a longer queer history in central Europe, and has helped inspire a Prague exhibition on masculinity.

item.title: The Pink Times : ChillOut takes its 30th anniversary launch to Melbourne for one-night party
item.description: The Daylesford pride festival is bringing its Lavendaze event to Windsor Siding on December 5, with DJs, surprise guests and a preview of next year’s expanded program.

item.title: The Pink Times : Voters shrugged off Republicans’ anti-trans ad blitz, poll finds
item.description: A post-election survey says most voters wanted less talk about trans issues, while only a small share of Republican voters named them as a reason for backing GOP candidates.

item.title: The Pink Times : New York yarn shops give men a place to knit and talk
item.description: At Cleo’s Yarn Shop in Brooklyn and Knitty City on the Upper West Side, participants say the groups offer steady company, easier conversation and less pressure around masculinity.

item.title: The Pink Times : Atlanta clears the way to demolish the house tied to Michael Hardwick’s arrest
item.description: Zoning officials approved the demolition request for the Ponce de Leon Place home where Hardwick was arrested in 1982. Preservation advocates had pushed for landmark review, but the property still lacks that protection.

item.title: The Pink Times : VeggieTales co-creator Phil Vischer says Scripture does not make God male
item.description: Vischer pushed back after a right-wing post mocked Texas Democrat James Talarico’s comments on God’s gender and drew fresh conservative criticism.

item.title: The Pink Times : Gold Coast Pride Formal opens more free tickets after fake RSVPs
item.description: The Gold Coast Pride Collective says some registrations for its first Pride Formal were claimed as a prank, but the event will still go ahead on November 21 at QT Gold Coast.

item.title: The Pink Times : Privy Council overturns Trinidad and Tobago’s laws criminalising same-sex intimacy
item.description: Jason Jones won his appeal after an 11-year legal fight. The ruling restores the 2018 High Court decision that struck down the island nation’s buggery and indecency laws.

item.title: The Pink Times : Pride in Protest seeks Mardi Gras Party review before November AGM
item.description: The activist group is backing a motion tied to Live Nation links, the event’s 2027 return, and Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras’ Ethical Charter.

item.title: The Pink Times : Mitchell Robertson lands Bill Bast role in James Dean biopic opposite Brandon Flynn
item.description: The Half Man actor joins One Hand Tied, which will adapt William Bast’s memoir Surviving James Dean.

item.title: The Pink Times : Tom of Finland foundation faces a public break with its cofounder
item.description: Durk Dehner says he was pushed out unfairly, while trustees say they are trying to stabilize the organization and protect the artist’s legacy.

item.title: The Pink Times : Emma D’Arcy talks nonbinary identity and fashion in Beauty Papers interview
item.description: The House of the Dragon star said clothes no longer feel like proof of gender, and described fashion as a space for shifting personas.

item.title: The Pink Times : Young Miko named Curve’s 2026 Sexiest Lesbian Alive
item.description: The Puerto Rican rapper won the title after more than 3,000 people voted in Curve magazine’s annual poll.

item.title: The Pink Times : New York appeals court voids Nassau County’s ban on trans athletes
item.description: A four-judge panel said the county’s rule conflicted with state human rights law and civil rights law. The ruling followed a two-year fight led by the attorney general, the Long Island Roller Rebels and Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman.

item.title: The Pink Times : Liberty's quick coaching split raises questions around Breanna Stewart and Chris DeMarco
item.description: Outsports reported that a new WNBA insider account points to tension between the star forward and the first-year coach after a July 18 loss to Indiana.

item.title: The Pink Times : Pennsylvania officer under review after video shows homophobic slur aimed at 15-year-old
item.description: Monongahela police say the officer remained on duty as the city and union reviewed the incident. Residents are calling for consequences after the clip spread on Facebook.

item.title: The Pink Times : Doug Jones’ son shares a warm note after Alabama loss
item.description: Carson Jones posted an Instagram tribute after his father’s gubernatorial defeat, thanking the family for a year on the trail and praising the campaign’s reach across Alabama.

item.title: The Pink Times : SNAP timing may affect whether people with HIV stick to treatment
item.description: A new study in Philadelphia found that adherence improved after monthly food benefits arrived, then slipped later in the cycle.

item.title: The Pink Times : Sarah McBride’s restraint paid off in Delaware and on Capitol Hill
item.description: The first out transgender member of Congress returned to Washington after a bruising first term, won reelection in Delaware and says her approach was built on patience, relationships and results.

item.title: The Pink Times : Supreme Court sends Colorado trans jail case back for review after two anti-trans rulings
item.description: The justices vacated a lower court win for Darlene Griffith and told the 10th Circuit to reconsider her equal protection claim in light of recent decisions on gender-affirming care and school sports.

item.title: The Pink Times : Jason Rapert urges prayer campaign against politicians and churches he says back LGBTQ people
item.description: The former Arkansas state senator said Republicans and church denominations are being taken over by the LGBTQ movement in a 16-page open letter published after last week’s midterms.

item.title: The Pink Times : Conservative backlash follows Democrats’ celebration of record LGBTQ wins in Congress
item.description: The Congressional Equality Caucus marked what it called the “gayest Congress in history” after the 2026 midterms, drawing angry responses from conservative commentators and lawmakers on X.

item.title: The Pink Times : John Violinist faces backlash after skipping a gay couple during anniversary callout
item.description: Rev. Darrell Goodwin says the musician ignored him and his husband Kenny at a Hartford concert, then later offered an apology and refund through private messages.

item.title: The Pink Times : Tracey Baim says queer media needs shared revenue, not one lifeline
item.description: The Windy City Times co-founder argues LGBTQ+ outlets are facing a long slide in ads, audience habits and platform control, and says collaboration could help them endure.

item.title: The Pink Times : Jesse Watters lashes out at Robert Garcia’s plan to probe Trump-era corruption
item.description: The Fox News host attacked the California Democrat after Garcia said he would pursue investigations when Democrats take the House in 2027.

item.title: The Pink Times : Victoria Broderick wins Tennessee House seat and becomes the state’s first out queer member of Congress
item.description: The Democrat defeated Scott DesJarlais by 280 votes in a district Donald Trump carried by 24 points in 2024.

item.title: The Pink Times : Grindr sets Edge at $120 a month and signals a pricier tier may follow
item.description: The company says its new premium product is meant to test demand now, while paving the way for higher-cost offerings later.
